notes.title: Bravehood F.A.Q. – The PvPvE Dungeoncrawler
notes.content:
Bravehood F.A.Q. – The PvPvE Dungeoncrawler

Dear players,

Our community is growing each day and our team gains responsibility for each person who expected a good game from our team. We have received a lot of questions and prepared Frequently Asked Questions for our community.


 Bravehood Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is Bravehood?

A: Bravehood is an online PvPvE Dungeoncrawler video game.
Q: How is the gameplay?
A: You create your own character and enter the dungeons with your team. You need to use potions, relics, and special weapon abilities to banish enemies in dungeons. You need to use your XP to level up and make your character stronger and create your own build.
Q: How is Bravehood PvPvE gameplay?
A: It is similar to Dark Souls PvP. There are some relics that have similar functions to dark souls, like Chameleon. You can make your own strategy by using well design maps with strategic points. Each team needs to dungeon the boss and extract the soul. 
Q: How is Dungeon PvP matchmaking?
A: You will choose dungeons like Minecraft Dungeons. If you enter the dungeon with PvP option enabled, you will be sent to a PvP game. You can be an invader and quickly join other people’s dungeons to invade them.
Q: How is Combat gameplay?
A: It is the basic and simplified version of Soulsborne. You can roll, attack, heavy attack, and use potions and relics. Enemies have poise and you need to break them to stun them.
Q: Which enemies are players going to face?
A: There are 5 regular enemy types in the game. With different gameplay, 5 mini-bosses, and 3 main bosses in the release version.

Q: How many people are in the team?
A: Currently 8 people.
M. Mustafa Yaya - Producer/Team Lead and Gameplay Programmer
Umut Gürdal - Development Team Lead and Gameplay Programmer
Nadir Kaan Sezi - Level & Game Designer
Efe Bektaş - Game Designer & Programmer
ibrahim Kayra Dural - Programmer
Emir Kaan Öz- Programmer
Kunter Çalışkan- Sound Designer
Aytek Kerem Küçük - Project Manager

We believe we will success with working hard and help of our community. Join us!
